description: World Rugby men's 15s world rankings from World Rugby's official rankings API: position, team, country code, rating points, and previous position and points, from the current table (World Rugby recalculates it after international matches). limit returns the top N teams (1 to 100, default 20); there is no team filter, so read the team you need from the list. Men's 15s only, no women's or sevens tables. For national football teams use sports_fifa_team_rankings. Related tools on this server, for a different need: sports_fifa_team_rankings when you need FIFA men's national team world ranking: position, team; sports_owgr_golf_rankings when you need Official World Golf Ranking: current men's position, player. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: How many teams from the top, 1 to 100 (default 20)
